name: Pylon
description: Calls down an orbital pylon onto any tile on the map. Pylons are special units that do not occupy a tile, but can still be attacked. Whenever Zenith casts Orbital Beam, each pylon will also cast a beam on a random adjcaent enemy unit. If a pylon is destroyed, adjacent enemy units are stunned for %death_duration% turns and take %death_damage% damage.
